names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Κοσμάς ο Α' Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κωνσταντινούπολης», with the rank word and the see left off.

floruit.note: His patriarchate, which is what saint.gr's page dates: «the emperor Michael Doukas brought Cosmas to the throne» after John VIII died on 2 August 1075, and «So on 8 May 1081» he withdrew to the monastery of Kallias. The page gives no year for his repose.
